text: Thus, before her, the mind-born desire was burned by the wielder of the Pāśupata arrow, and the woman, whose hopes were shattered, was censured. For, O Parvati, beauty is the fruit of auspiciousness among the beloved. How, then, can one attain a state of barrenness through meditation and austerities of the self? Or, by what other means can one obtain such a twofold love and a husband of such a nature?
